A.1. Original Steak Sauce 425g (Kraft): The classic dark steak sauce, 425g. Tangy and fruity from tomato, raisin and vinegar — sharp rather than sweet.
Artisanal Hot Sauce 150ml (Peculiar): Small-batch hot sauce from Peculiar, 150ml, in three different blends. Ask at the counter which is the hottest — the names give nothing away.
Artisanal Olio Piccante 250ml (Peculiar): Chilli-infused olive oil from Peculiar, 250ml. Warm and gently hot, the heat carried in the oil rather than sitting on top of it.
Artisanal Spiced Vinegar 500ml (Peculiar: Spiced vinegar from Peculiar, 500ml. Sharp and aromatic, with the spices taking the hard edge off the sourness.
Asparagus in Brine 430g (Hosen): White asparagus spears in brine, 430g. Soft and mild with a faint bitterness, and saltier than fresh asparagus.
Balsamic Vinegar 500ml (Dolce Vita): Italian balsamic vinegar, 500ml. Dark, syrupy and sweet-sour, far rounder than wine vinegar.
Barbecue Sauce (Sweet Baby Ray's): The American barbecue sauce, thick and dark. Sweet first, then smoky and tangy, with a molasses depth underneath.
Black Pitted Olives 900g (Dolce Vita): Pitted black olives, 900g. Soft, mild and salty — gentler in flavour than green olives.
Capers in Vinegar 140g (Dolce Vita): Caper buds in vinegar, 140g. Small, sharp and salty, with a bright floral bitterness.
Cherry Tomatoes 425ml(Mazza): Whole cherry tomatoes in juice, 425ml. Sweeter and less acidic than chopped tomatoes, and they keep their shape.
Chickpeas 400g (Dolce Vita): Cooked chickpeas in a tin, 400g. Firm and nutty with a mild, earthy flavour.
Chopped Tomatoes 400g (Dolce Vita): Chopped tomatoes in their juice, 400g. Bright and acidic with a clean tomato flavour.
Coconut Milk Powder 120g (Fiesta): Powdered coconut milk, 120g. Rich and sweet, and it mixes to whatever thickness is wanted.
Condensed Soup Cream of Chicken (298g (C: Campbell's condensed cream of chicken soup, 298g. Thick and savoury straight from the tin, mild and creamy once let down with liquid.
Course Mustard 255g (Kühne): Wholegrain mustard from Kühne, 255g. Mild and tangy with whole seeds that pop — far gentler than Dijon.
Cream of Mushroom (Campbell's): Campbell's condensed cream of mushroom soup. Thick and earthy from the tin, mild and creamy once let down.
Cream Style Sweet Corn 425g (Members Val: Creamed sweetcorn, 425g. Thick, soft and sweet, with whole kernels through the purée.
Dijon Mustard 370g (Bornier): French Dijon mustard from Bornier, 370g. Smooth, sharp and strongly hot, with a clean vinegar bite.
Double Cheddar Cheese Sauce 439g (Ragu): Ready-made cheddar cheese sauce from Ragu, 439g. Thick, salty and mild, pourable straight from the jar.
Green Pitted Olives 340g (Dolce Vita): Pitted green olives, 340g. Firm and salty, with a sharper and more bitter edge than the black ones.
Green Sliced Jalapeno Peppers 340g (Dolc: Sliced jalapeños in brine, 340g. Tangy and moderately hot, the vinegar taking some of the edge off the heat.
Grünkohl nach Oldenburger Art 660g (Kühn: German kale in the Oldenburg style, 660g. Dark, soft and savoury, with a mild cabbage flavour.
Honey Mustard Sauce 250g (CJ): Honey mustard sauce, 250g. Sweet first, with a mild mustard warmth arriving behind it.
Horseradish ready-to-use 140g (Kühne): Grated horseradish, ready to use, 140g. Fiercely sharp — a heat that hits the nose rather than the tongue.
Kernel Corn 425g (Member's Value): Whole sweetcorn kernels in a tin, 425g. Sweet and juicy with a firm bite.
Liver Pate 250g (Sausage Guy): Liver pâté under our own label, 250g. Smooth and rich, the deep mineral flavour of liver softened by fat.
Mayonnaise Japanese Style 300g (Kewpie): Kewpie Japanese mayonnaise, 300g. Richer and tangier than Western mayonnaise, with a savoury depth from rice vinegar.
Old Fashioned Sauerkraut 946ml (Vlasic): Fermented white cabbage, 946ml. Sour, salty and crunchy, and sharper than the German jars.
Organic Apple Cider Vinegar 946ml (Kirkl: Organic apple cider vinegar, 946ml. Sharp and fruity, softer and rounder than white vinegar.
Organic Chicken Stock 946ml (Kirkland Si: Organic chicken stock, 946ml, ready to pour. Light and savoury, much milder than a stock made from powder.
Original Dijon Mustard 185g(Kühne): Dijon mustard from Kühne, 185g. Smooth and sharp, with a strong clean heat.
Peanut Butter Creamy 800g (Herman): Smooth peanut butter from Herman, 800g. Thick, sweet and nutty, with no pieces in it.
Peanut Butter Creamy 800g (Member's Valu: Smooth peanut butter, 800g. Thick, sweet and nutty — the plainer of the two creamy jars.
Peanut Butter Crunchy 800g (Herman): Crunchy peanut butter from Herman, 800g. Thick and nutty, with chopped peanuts through it.
Peanut Butter Crunchy 800g (Member's Val: Crunchy peanut butter, 800g, with chopped peanuts through it. The plainer of the two crunchy jars.
Pesto alla Genovese 180g (Mazza): Green basil pesto, 180g. Herbal and salty, tasting of basil, cheese and pine nut, with a grainy texture.
Pesto Rosso 180g (Mazza): Red pesto made with tomato, 180g. Sweeter and deeper than the green one, less herbal and more savoury.
Pickled Gherkins 670g (Kühne): Pickled gherkins from Kühne, 670g. Crunchy and sharply sour, with a little sweetness behind the vinegar.
Pickled Onions 330g (Kühne): Small pickled onions, 330g. Crunchy and sharp, sweet-sour with a mild onion bite.
Pizza Sauce 400g (Mazza): Seasoned tomato sauce for pizza, 400g. Smooth and mildly herby, less acidic than plain chopped tomatoes.
Red Cabbage 350g (Kühne): German-style red cabbage, 350g. Soft and sweet-sour, with a faint fruity spice running through it.
Red Kidney Beans (Dolce Vita): Cooked red kidney beans in a tin. Soft and floury inside, with a mild and slightly sweet flavour.
Sauerkraut Choucroute 720ml (Kühne): German sauerkraut, 720ml. Sour and salty, but milder and softer than the American jar.
Sriracha Hot Chili Sauce 440ml (Crying T: Sriracha from Crying Thaiger, 440ml. Hot, garlicky and a little sweet, thick enough to pour slowly.
Sriracha Mayo Chili Sauce 440ml (Crying: Sriracha blended into mayonnaise, 440ml. Creamy and only mildly hot — much gentler than the plain sriracha.
Sriracha Wasabi Chili Sauce 440ml (Cryin: Sriracha with wasabi, 440ml. Hot in two ways at once — chilli on the tongue, wasabi up the nose.
Sun-Dried Tomatoes 280g (Dolce Vita): Sun-dried tomatoes in oil, 280g. Chewy and intensely sweet-tangy, far more concentrated than fresh tomato.
Sweet Mustard 260g(Kühne): Bavarian-style sweet mustard, 260g. Mild, coarse and clearly sweet — the mustard that belongs with a Weisswurst.
Sweet Red Pepper 390g (Mazza): Roasted sweet red peppers in a jar, 390g. Soft, sweet and faintly smoky, with no heat at all.
Sweet Relish 710ml (Vlasic): Sweet pickle relish, 710ml. Finely chopped and crunchy, clearly sweet with a vinegar edge.
Whole Garbanzos Chickpeas 425g (Members: Cooked whole chickpeas in a tin, 425g. Firm and nutty with a mild, earthy flavour.
Whole Green Peas Choice 425g (Members Va: Cooked green peas in a tin, 425g. Soft and mildly sweet, gentler than frozen peas.
Whole Mushroom in Can 425g (Member's Val: Whole button mushrooms in brine, 425g. Soft and mild, with a faint earthiness and a little salt.
Whole Young Corn 425g (Member's Value): Baby corn in brine, 425g. Crunchy and mildly sweet, eaten cob and all.
Yellowfin Tuna 185g (Delimondo): Yellowfin tuna from Delimondo, 185g, in three styles — olive oil, spiced olive oil, and chunks in brine. Firm, meaty flakes rather than mush.
